reveal_en: Archaeologists have discovered pots of honey in ancient Egyptian tombs that are thousands of years old and still perfectly edible. Its unique chemical composition prevents spoilage indefinitely.
reveal_zh: 考古学家在古埃及陵墓中发现了数千年前的蜂蜜，至今仍可食用。它独特的化学成分使其永不腐坏。
meaning_en: This natural wonder reminds us that some of nature's simplest creations hold incredible, enduring properties.
meaning_zh: 这个自然奇迹提醒我们，大自然最简单的创造也蕴含着不可思议的持久特性。
